'''PMC-210 medical capsules''' were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles developed by [[Praxen Emergency Medical Supplies, Limited|Praxen Emergency Medical Services]] for the transport of critically injured patients from the battlefield to more secure and better equipped medical facilities. A [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] was incorporated into the PMC-210 which helped regulate and monitor the life signs of a patient. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] was carried away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in a PMC-210 [[Medical capsule/Legends|medical capsule]] following his [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|defeat]] at the hands of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
